iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear
iran_nuclear.notes: Day 48. POSITIVE: 2-week ceasefire reached Apr 7-8 (AP/Reuters). Iran indicated willingness to turn over enriched uranium (White House). Trump calls Iran 10-point plan "workable." BUT: NYT reports ceasefire leaves questions over uranium fate - Trump says sites under "intense satellite surveillance." Hegseth: Iran defence-industrial base "completely" destroyed. IAEA: Natanz aboveground destroyed, inspectors evicted except power/research reactors. 440kg 60% HEU still at Isfahan. Iranian parliament speaker called ceasefire "unreasonable" citing Lebanon violations. Technical: CRITICAL unchanged. Diplomatic: HIGH. Probability DOWN to 35%. Falling.

iran_conventional.name: Iran Conventional
iran_conventional.notes: Day 48. CRITICAL: Strait of Hormuz NOT open despite ceasefire. Abu Dhabi oil chief confirms strait closed. Iran FM says passage allowed for 2 weeks under "Iranian military management." Windward: volumes 93% down, permission-based regime via Larak Island. Iran 10-point plan says Hormuz subject to "regulated passage." Oil bounced back to ~$110 after brief dip to $95. Bloomberg: oil shock "heading west" - refined fuels topping $200. IEA: worse than 1973+1979+2022 combined. Iran attacked Saudi pipeline bypass route. UK-led 40-nation coalition discussions ongoing. Mobilization: CRITICAL. Diplomatic: LOW. Probability UP to 38%. Rising.

israel_lebanon.name: Israel–Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: Day 48. VOLATILE: Israel struck 100+ targets in 10 minutes across Lebanon on Apr 8 (Al Jazeera/AP) - 254+ killed, 1,000+ wounded. Netanyahu says ceasefire does NOT include Lebanon. Largest coordinated strike since March 1. BUT: Netanyahu authorized direct talks with Lebanon (AP Apr 9) - first diplomatic opening. Hezbollah paused attacks under ceasefire (Reuters). Iran parliament cited Lebanon attacks as ceasefire violation. 1,500+ total killed, 1M displaced. Talks authorization lowers probability slightly. Rhetoric: CRITICAL. Mobilization: CRITICAL. Diplomatic: MEDIUM. Probability DOWN to 65%. Still most volatile zone.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.notes: NATO Steadfast Dart-2026 exercise ongoing. OSW analysis: Turkey pursuing strategic ambiguity on nuclear weapons. FM Fidan: Iran ambitions could push Turkey into nuclear arms race. Israel Hayom warns Turkish nuclear weapon risk. Akkuyu nuclear plant commissioning. B61-12 transition excludes Turkey. Stable at 11%.

india.name: India–Pakistan
india.notes: ESCALATORY: US Annual Threat Assessment: India-Pakistan relations "remain at risk of nuclear conflict." CFR rates renewed conflict as Tier II contingency (moderate risk) - warns of potential armed conflict in 2026. Pakistan Defence Minister nuclear signaling continues. India rejects US mediation. Carnegie: analysis of nuclear noise and signaling patterns. Rhetoric: HIGH. Diplomatic: LOW. Probability UP to 24%. Rising.

russia.name: Russia (Nuclear Signaling)
russia.notes: Day 48. Iran war = strategic windfall for Russia (Axios/WaPo/Zakaria): surging oil, diverted Western attention, strained NATO. Russia concerned about NPT Review Conference. Medvedev nuclear threats continue. Rutte: NATO moving from "unhealthy" dependence on US. Russia Matters: surging prices and sanctions easing "pumping billions into Russia war chest." New START expired Feb 2026, no replacement. Strategic Rocket Forces 90% modernized. Probability stable at 56%.

china.name: China
china.notes: ESCALATING: ISW China-Taiwan Update Apr 3 confirms ongoing PLA activity. Taiwan Warns of China Hybrid Tactics (Apr 8). KMT Chairwoman Cheng Li-wun Beijing visit. Taiwan military: budget delay threatens $2.4B weapons buying + F-16 training. CNN: China secretly expanding nuclear weapons infrastructure. Asia Times: nuclear-response drills for Taiwan scenario. PLA 2026 combat training across all forces launched. Technical: CRITICAL. Mobilization: HIGH. Probability UP to 15%. Rising.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: 3RD missile launch in 2 days (Apr 8) - multiple SRBMs from Wonsan, 240km each (AP/Boston25/Politico). DPRK tested "Hwasong-11Ka" variant. VP FM Jang Kum-chol: South Korea most hostile enemy state. Kim observed cruise missile test from new destroyer. Constitutional nuclear status irreversible. Kim demands US nuclear recognition. 38 North: solid-propellant ICBM, tactical nukes, LACMs all deployed. Rhetoric: CRITICAL. Technical: CRITICAL. Stable at 88%.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia–Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: War Year 4, Day 1140+. Russia concocting Ukrainian bomb claims - potential pretext for nuclear escalation (confirmed by ACA). Kremlin warns of potential threat of Ukraine acquiring nuclear weapons. Express: Russian media figure advocating 48-hour nuclear ultimatum to Ukraine. New START expired Feb 2026, no replacement. GCRI nuclear war analysis published. Bulletin Doomsday Clock: nuclear risk continued in third year of war. Probability stable at 80%.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan–Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: DIPLOMATIC BREAKTHROUGH SUSTAINED: China-hosted Urumqi talks confirmed (AP/Al Jazeera/NPR/Reuters). Both sides committed to ceasefire and "comprehensive solution." China FM spokesperson Mao Ning: actively mediating. VP Vance delegation heading to Islamabad. Sporadic mortar incidents continue but ceasefire largely holding. Taliban abandoned some border posts. Diplomatic: HIGH. Probability DOWN to 5%. Falling.
